Absent deep tendon reflexes and a respiratory rate below 12 breaths/minute (Respiratory rate is 9 breaths/minute) are key signs of magnesium toxicity and require immediate nursing action, including stopping the magnesium infusion and potentially administering calcium gluconate. The nurse must identify these abnormal findings to ensure timely intervention.
